February 3, 34.

Dear Mr. Sarly,

I forward herewith for your information tabulated statement relating to the arrest by the Municipal Police of a communist named Wong Chun Lai (王俊来) alias Wong Yue Bi (王牛度) at 11.30 p.m. January 26, 1934 at No.30 Shing Li, Thorburn Road.

The accused appeared on remand before the Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court on January 31, 1934 and was ordered to be handed over to the Chinese authorities.

Yours sincerely,
（签名）

Monsieur R. Sarly,
Chief of the Political Section,
French Police Headquarters.

Accused Wong Chun Lai ( ) Age 28. Unemployed.

Charge Application is hereby made for the detention for further enquiries of the above named person who was arrested at 11.30 p.m. on 25/1/34 at No 30 Vec Shing Lee, off Thorburn Road and who is wanted by the P.S.B. Nantao on a charge of being a communist.

HIGH COURT. A.H.

Proceedings. Mr T.Y. Chang appeared for the Police.

Mr Chang:- At about 11.30.p.m. on the 26/1/34, the accused was arrested at No.30.Vec Shing Lee, off Thorburn Road, on the authority of a warrant issued by the 1st Special District Court, at the request of the P.S.B. The accused was arrested in the kitchen at the above address, nothing of a communistic nature was found. When the accused was questioned he denied being a communist, but he was identified by an informer of the S.P.S.B.

Tsiang Au Wu Lep, of the S.P.S.B.:- The accused was identified by the informer as being an officer of the Organising Dept, of the Communist Party, in the Eastern Area.

Tsang Yeong Ching Vit:- The accused is a member of the Organizing Dept, and he is known as Wong Yue Bi, I knew the accused when I was a member of the Communist Party about three months ago. I met the accused in the Wayside District. I surrendered myself to the S.P.S.B.

Accused:- I have no alias as Wong Yue Bi. I do not know the witness. I am not a communist. I do not know Lau Li.

Tsang Yeong Ching Vit:- Lau Li, is the chief of the Organising Dept, and visited the accused's home.

Accused:- Lau Li, did not visit my home.

DECISION. Remand to 31/1/34/. 1.30.P.M. for trial. Accused to be detained in custody.

G.L.

被告 王俊来 ( ) 年龄 28岁。 失业。

指控 兹申请拘留上述人员以作进一步调查，该人于34年1月25日晚上11时30分在韬宾路旁 Vec Shing Lee 30号被捕，且因涉嫌为共产党人而被南市公安局通缉。

高等法院。 A.H.

诉讼程序。 T.Y. Chang 先生代表警方出庭。

Chang 先生：- 34年1月26日晚上11时30分左右，被告根据第一特区法院签发的搜查令，应公安局的要求，在韬宾路旁 Vec Shing Lee 30号被捕。被告在上述地址的厨房内被捕，未发现任何具有共产主义性质的物品。在对被告进行讯问时，他否认自己是共产党人，但被上海市公安局的一名线人指认。

上海市公安局的 Tsiang Au Wu Lep：- 线人指认被告为共产党东部地区组织部的干部。

Tsang Yeong Ching Vit：- 被告是组织部成员，化名为王牛皮，大约三个月前我还是共产党成员时就认识被告。我在韦斯特区（Wayside District）见过被告。我向上海市公安局自首。

被告：- 我没有王牛皮这个别名。我不认识这位证人。我不是共产党人。我不认识刘李（Lau Li）。

Tsang Yeong Ching Vit：- 刘李（Lau Li）是组织部长，曾去过被告家。

被告：- 刘李没有去过我家。

裁决。 还押至34年1月31日下午1时30分受审。 被告予以羁押。

G.L.

Jong Chun Lai ( 王春來 )
Kiangsu                                          S. Jones
Yulin Rd. No.          Jan. 27, 1934,           Clerk Fung Nuo Liang

My name is Jong Chun Lai, 28, native of Kiangsu.
From the age of 9 to 11 years I studied under a private
tutor at my home in Kwei Yuen Anism(      ), Hompo. My
father is co-proprietor of the Hung Fong(      ) Grain Shop
at Kwei Yuen. When I was 16 years of age I learned the
weaving business, making cloth on my own loom and retailing
it to various piece goods shops. For five years I earned my
living in this manner and then I got a job as an operative
at a small weaving manufactory at Tong Kien(      ), a village
near my home. I worked there for 2 years and then, at the
age of 23, came to Shanghai. On this occasion I remained
four months working at the Woong Huh Kyi(      ) Cotton Mill
in Nan Chou Road, Chapel. At the end of this period I
returned to my native village. I went to work again at the
manufactory in Tong Kien and stayed there for another 3 years.
In April 1932 I came again to Shanghai. I got a job
shortly after my arrival at the Soo Teh Spinning Mill, Nam
Shu Road, Chapel. I resigned in the beginning of 1933.
Shortly after this I went to work at a weaving factory in Chang
Shing Road, Chapel. I remained in this employment until a
month ago on account of slack business. I was discharged.
Since then I have been unemployed. During the time I have
lived in Shanghai I have resided at my place of work. I have
resided at my present address since my discharge from my
last place of employment.
I am not a Communist and do not belong to any political
party.
(Signed) Jong Chun Lai.

Jong Chun Lai （王春來）
江苏                                          S. Jones
玉林路 编号          1934年1月27日，           书记员 Fung Nuo Liang

我叫 Jong Chun Lai，28岁，江苏籍。
9岁至11岁时，我在虹口桂缘安尼斯姆（原文不清）的家中跟随私人教师学习。我的父亲是桂缘洪丰（原文不清）粮店的共同经营者。16岁时，我学习了织布手艺，用自己的织布机织布，并零售给各家布店。我以这种方式谋生了五年，然后在我家乡附近的 Tong Kien（原文不清）村的一家小型织布厂找到了一份操作工的工作。我在那里工作了2年，然后在23岁时来到上海。这次我在南周路闸北的 Woong Huh Kyi（原文不清）棉纺厂工作了四个月。期满后，我回到了家乡。我又去 Tong Kien 的工厂工作，并在那里又待了3年。
1932年4月，我再次来到上海。抵达后不久，我在闸北南舒路的 Soo Teh 纺纱厂找到了一份工作。1933年初我辞职了。不久之后，我去闸北昌盛路的一家织布厂工作。由于生意清淡，我一直受雇到一个月前。我被解雇了。从那以后我一直失业。在上海居住期间，我住在工作的地方。自从上一份工作被解雇后，我就一直住在现在的地址。
我不是共产党人，也不属于任何政党。
（签名） Jong Chun Lai。
